links.outcome: Utilization and user experience of two ambient scribe vendors compared in local pilot
links.effect: Vendor B showed higher utilization rates and superior user experience compared to Vendor A.
links.quote: "Vendor B" showed higher utilization rates and superior user experience compared to "Vendor A."

links.outcome: Local pre-post documentation time savings with ambient scribes
links.effect: 0.35-min-per-note and 2.07-min-per-day reduction in documentation time versus the prior 3-month period.
links.quote: Compared to the 3-month period immediately prior to initiating the ambient trial, clinicians experienced a 0.35-min-per-note and a 2.07-min-per-day reduction in documentation time.

unlisted_practices: Executive sponsorship and strong vendor partnership for ambient scribe implementation
Objective and key results (OKR) metrics for structured evaluation
Dedicated ongoing technical support and training resourcing

screen.reason: Evaluates the implementation of two commercial ambient documentation tools among 97 ambulatory clinicians in real clinical workflows without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice modification.
